positions.title: Apprentice Developer
positions.description: Developed a Rails/React app with a team of three others in conjunction with a NYC design firm for a non-profit client. The web app was test driven with RSpec and Mocha and interacts with numerous internal and external APIs.

volunteerExperiences.description: Mentorship to students (generally under-represented people in technology) of programming and web development.
I co-led a team of 6 developers at an event, Ruby by the Bay, to build a greenfield Rails app over the course of a weekend for CASA, a non-profit serving foster youth. Development work is ongoing.
